title: Jensen Huang affair puts Nvidia's future at risk, with no clear successor to the renowned CEO
summary_full: Jensen Huang is practically synonymous with Nvidia, the chipmaker he co-founded in 1993 and turned into one of the most valuable companies on the planet.
